title: Signing the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Contract at Pickup
content:
**Counter reference — the renter's signature at pickup on a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental contract.**

## Rule

When the renter signs the truck rental contract at pickup, an authorization hold is placed on the card on file with the reservation and the contract moves to picked-up status with the pickup readings the renter records. The authorization hold is fixed only after the contract's first-day rental fee stands posted on the contract.

In the same terms: while no first-day rental fee stands posted on the contract, the authorization hold is not fixed.

## What the signing does

The signing is the renter's own act. It moves the reservation to picked-up status with the pickup date and time stamped at the moment of signing, and records on the contract the fleet number, the odometer and fuel readings, the damage waiver choice and the number of additional drivers given. An authorization hold for the amount given is placed on the card on file with the reservation, dated the pickup date, and the hold on the contract rises by that amount. The renter sees the contract as signed and the vehicle released, with the hold shown against the card.

## How it is invoked

`sign_truck_rental_contract_074f2414` is a hand-over tool owned by the customer: the agent unlocks it as a customer-side tool and hands it over, and the customer themselves signs by running it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `truck_rental_id` | The truck rental contract number of the renter's reservation, read from the truck rental lookup | Identifier |
| `customer_id` | The customer reference number of the renter signing, read from the customer profile lookup | Identifier |
| `truck_unit_number` | The fleet number of the vehicle handed over, exactly as the renter reads it from the key tag | Verbatim, copied character for character with no change |
| `odometer_out` | The odometer reading at pickup as the renter reads it | Integer miles |
| `fuel_out_eighths` | The fuel gauge reading at pickup | Integer from 0 to 8, in eighths of a tank |
| `damage_waiver` | The damage waiver the renter takes at signing | One of: `none` (the renter declines any waiver and carries the full repair estimate for damage), `basic` (the renter buys the basic damage waiver and carries damage up to its deductible), `premium` (the renter buys the premium damage waiver with its lower deductible) |
| `additional_drivers` | The number of additional authorized drivers added at signing | Integer; 0 when the renter is the only driver |
| `deposit_hold_amount` | The authorization hold placed on the card, in USD | Positive amount rounded to 2 decimal places |

## Return

On success the tool returns `status` "picked_up", `truck_rental_id`, `actual_pickup` (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS with the time zone), `truck_unit_number` (as recorded), `hold_id` (the id of the hold entry), `deposit_hold_amount` (the hold placed, USD with 2 decimal places) and `hold_on_card` (the total hold now on the contract, USD with 2 decimal places). A status of "picked_up" means the contract is signed and the vehicle released.
